ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation concentrated at the distal tips and along the leading edges; white high-intensity ground in the central lobe regions heavily bisected by low-intensity linear streaks and localized mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of 130 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with low-amplitude peaks (3-8 pixels) and valleys; higher frequency of jaggedness observed on the trailing edge of the left lobe relative to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges tapering into sharp, elongated lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small clusters of high-intensity circular pixel nodes (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) visible at the terminal lateral edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, low-intensity linear pixel strings (rake marks) ranging from 1 to 4 pixels in width, predominantly oriented diagonally across the white central ground.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-directional rake mark scarring across the entire visible surface; visible barnacle colonization at the lateral fluke tips.
